newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Emperor Mines in A$17.4 mln placement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Emperor Mines in A$17.4 mln placement.

text.p: Emperor Mines Ltd said on Friday it would place a parcel of 7.39 million shares with Prudential Bache Securities at A$2.35 a share to raise A$17.4 million.
The Fiji-based gold miner said it would also issue 740,000 shares at a price of A$2.35 to its chairman Tan Sri Azmi Wan Hamzah to raise A$1.7 million.
Emperor said it expected to draw down its credit facility by up to A$16.3 million by the end of the year.

"Given the current lower gold price and the expected credit draw down, the directors agreed it was prudent to make the above placement to ensure that the company's committment to remain minimally hedged continues," Emperor said. Emperor's shares were unchanged at A$2.50 at 1.30 p.m. (0330 GMT).
